mechanism: Itraconazole inhibits CYP3A4, which may increase valproic acid metabolism unpredictably; valproic acid may also displace itraconazole from protein binding and inhibit its metabolism via CYP3A4, increasing itraconazole levels.
action: Monitor valproic acid and itraconazole serum concentrations; watch for signs of valproic acid toxicity (tremor, ataxia, somnolence) or reduced antifungal efficacy; consider therapeutic drug monitoring.
